title: 내일 뭐 입지?
제일 쉬운 4개
cta_kicker: 내일 저녁, 남자 아이돌 사복 해부

segments.label: 김유정
en: 01 Fuzzy shearling jacket — short length, wear it open
02 Ivory mock neck tee — a light layer brightens the look
03 Glossy leather Boston bag — keep the shine to one spot

segments.label: 트레버 로렌스
en: 01 Ivory mock neck — show just one layer at the neck
02 Dark denim zip jacket — zip it only halfway
03 Dark straight jeans — same wash depth as the jacket

segments.label: 케빈 듀런트
en: 01 Striped shirt — tuck it in, roll the sleeves once
02 Black leather belt — a thin belt cleans up the waist
03 Navy slacks — let the hem break at the ankle

segments.label: 차정원
en: 01 Sky blue windbreaker — roomy fit, wear it open
02 Black top over a white tee — let the hem peek out
03 Gray pleated mini skirt — kills the hiking-gear vibe
04 White socks + white sneakers — pull the socks above the ankle
